summary.en-US: Local RSS/Atom reader with WebDAV sync, full-text extraction and automatic refresh.
summary.zh-CN: RSS/Atom 阅读器：本地保存，支持 WebDAV 同步、全文提取与自动刷新。

description.en-US:
Read your RSS and Atom subscriptions in a dedicated reader tab. Dox Reader keeps subscriptions, downloaded articles, read state and starred items in your browser. The reader interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.

Features:
- Organize feeds and browse unread, all or starred articles.
- Search cached articles and import or export subscriptions using OPML.
- Customize the reading layout, colors and typography.
- Fetch the full text of summary-only articles on demand and keep it on the device.
- Refresh feeds automatically at a per-device interval.
- Optionally sync subscriptions, read/starred state, refresh metadata and preferences through your own HTTPS WebDAV server. Article bodies and images stay on each device.

No Dox Reader account or developer-operated service is required. The extension contains no advertising or analytics. Broad website access is needed to request the feed addresses, article pages and WebDAV server you choose; it does not inspect your browsing history. Article images can load from their original hosts.

Requires Firefox 142 or later on desktop or Android. Questions and bug reports: https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/issues
description.zh-CN:
在独立阅读器标签页中阅读 RSS 和 Atom 订阅。Dox Reader 将订阅、下载的文章、已读与收藏状态保存在浏览器本地，当前阅读器界面为简体中文。

主要功能：
- 按未读、全部文章或收藏浏览内容，管理订阅源。
- 搜索缓存文章，通过 OPML 导入和导出订阅。
- 调整阅读布局、配色和字体。
- 对只有摘要的文章按需提取全文，结果只保存在本机。
- 按本机设置的间隔自动刷新订阅。
- 可选连接自己的 HTTPS WebDAV 服务，同步订阅、已读与收藏状态、刷新时间和偏好；文章正文与图片保留在各设备本地。

无需 Dox Reader 账号或开发者运营的服务，不含广告或分析。访问网站权限用于请求你添加的订阅地址、原文页面和 WebDAV 服务，不用于读取浏览历史。文章图片可能从原始图片服务器加载。

支持 Firefox 142 及以上桌面版和 Android 版。问题反馈：https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/issues

release_notes.en-US: Fix WebDAV sync and read actions on plain-HTTP deployments, keep mark-read usable during background refresh, and time out stalled feed requests.
release_notes.zh-CN: 修复 HTTP 部署下的 WebDAV 同步与阅读操作，后台刷新时标记已读仍可用，并为卡住的订阅请求增加超时。
